title: IShowSpeed wins Streamer of the Year at the Streamer Awards for a third straight year
dek: The streaming industry's main awards night ended with one of the biggest names online taking its top prize again.
what: The 2026 Streamer Awards were held on 12 November 2026. Complex reports IShowSpeed won Streamer of the Year for the third year in a row. Netinfluencer and KeenGamer carry the same result; I opened only Complex's page.
Complex also has IShowSpeed taking Best IRL Streamer and Best Streamed Series for his World Cup Tour, and Jynxzi taking Gamer of the Year.
Two posts on X from the night say he gave his speech in Indonesian. I could not confirm that outside X, so treat it as what the posts say.
why: A single clip of the winning moment reached far more people than the awards themselves. The speech language gave it a hook outside gaming.
next: Nothing further is pending. The full winners list is on the sites listed below.
